blocked_sentences: You may have this artifact enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact and it has "{T}: Add {U}."

needs.what: a 'set_types' exception on a self_enters_as_copy replacement's except_ (707.9b): the copy's card types are REPLACED by the printed list (here exactly ["Artifact"]), so the copy is not a creature, its creature subtypes go away (205.1b), and its copied power/toughness stop mattering
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The packet's reference has no self_enters_as_copy replacement at all; in the engine, ENTERS_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (cards/loader) carries add_types (Phyrexian Metamorph's 'in addition to its other types'), add_subtypes, add_keywords, colors, no_mana_cost, remove_supertypes, name, enters_with and condition, but nothing that replaces the type line, so 'except it's an artifact' would arrive as an artifact creature

needs.what: an exception key on a self_enters_as_copy replacement's except_ that adds a quoted ability (by grantable_abilities index) to the copiable values, here the mana ability "{T}: Add {U}.", so it is part of the copy and survives being copied again
needs.why_existing_wont_do: except_ has add_keywords only, for keyword abilities; the grant_ability op and static grant to a permanent rather than writing into its copiable values, and nothing here grants an activated mana ability as part of the copy
